name: Anjali Menon
selfIntro: Hi, I'm Anjali from Kochi. I love long conversations about movies, music and everything in between. If you need someone to talk to after a long day, I'm here.

name: Meera Nair
selfIntro: Namaskaram! I'm Meera, a good listener who believes every problem feels lighter when it's shared. Let's talk about whatever is on your mind, no judgement.

name: Devika Krishnan
selfIntro: Final-year student, coffee addict and full-time motivator. If exams or career decisions are stressing you out, let's figure it out together.

name: Lakshmi Pillai
selfIntro: I'm Lakshmi from Thrissur. Calm conversations, honest advice and a listening ear for anything from family matters to life decisions.

name: Nandana Suresh
selfIntro: Bookworm, foodie and travel planner. I can talk about Kozhikode biriyani for hours, but I'm equally happy just listening to your day.

name: Gowri Varma
selfIntro: From the backwaters of Alappuzha. Night owl, patient listener and happy to help you practise English or Malayalam while we chat.

name: Parvathy Raj
selfIntro: Former school counsellor turned full-time listener. If you want practical, kind advice about work, studies or family, I'm a call away.

name: Aiswarya Das
selfIntro: Beach person, gym person, chai person. Let's swap stories, plan imaginary trips or just laugh about our day.
